fields.name: ShardsValues enumeration entry
fields.description: The public entry shape produced when ShardsValues is enumerated: a shard without named values is represented by one placeholder entry, while a shard with named values produces one entry per mapping.

members.name: ShardId
members.description: The shard identifier represented by the entry.

members.name: ParameterName
members.description: The mapping name; absent for a placeholder entry representing a shard without values.

members.name: ParameterValue
members.description: The mapped value; absent for a placeholder entry representing a shard without values.

representations.CSharp: ShardParameterValue yielded by ShardsValues' IEnumerable<ShardParameterValue> implementation; Shards is IDictionary<short, IDictionary<string, object>>.
